title: DAILY FIGHTER — WEEK 2 DAY 9
emphasis: Foundation Friday HARD shifted safely: front-lever bodyline regression, pain-free horizontal strength, heavy hinge, spinal-engine rotation, swing power, carries, and repeatable conditioning

levels.bonus: Optional 5–10 min easy mobility. BJJ: Ignition + A×2/B×1 (19:00), or skip if class/time load is high.

ignition.name: Jump-Rope Intervals
ignition.home: Easy jump rope and relaxed marching
ignition.cue: RPE 5; low bounce, loose shoulders, nasal recovery

deposits.label: A
deposits.title: FRONT-LEVER FOUNDATION REGRESSION
deposits.effort: Rest 1:00; RPE 6, 5 RIR. Last qualifying rung: tuck hold 3×10 sec on 9/15. No progression today; gate remains two clean 3×15–20-sec tuck-hold exposures ≤RPE 8 after symptoms permit.

exercises.name: Dopa Band Lying Pulldown
exercises.cue: Symptom-free range only; ribs down; no hanging

exercises.name: Hollow-Body Hold
exercises.cue: Lower back down; ribs tucked; breathe

deposits.label: B
deposits.title: PAIN-FREE HORIZONTAL STRENGTH
deposits.effort: Rest 1:15; 4 RIR, RPE 6. Repeat known reps at easier load/tension; no shoulder progression.

exercises.name: One-Arm Cable Row
exercises.cue: Square torso; elbow toward hip; symptom-free pull

exercises.name: Dopa Band Standing Chest Press
exercises.cue: Pain-free range; ribs stacked; smooth return

deposits.label: C
deposits.title: HEAVY HINGE + SPINAL ENGINE
deposits.effort: Rest 1:15; RDL 3 RIR/RPE ≤8. Record load; missing prior load means no credited load progression.

exercises.name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.cue: Hips back; lats quiet; stand without overextending

exercises.name: Dopa Band Tornado Torso Twist
exercises.cue: Rotate hips and upper back together; brake cleanly

deposits.label: D
deposits.title: HINGE POWER
deposits.effort: Rest 0:45; RPE 6. Stop when hip snap, bell height, or posture declines.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Swing
exercises.cue: Violent hip snap; arms stay relaxed; no grinding

deposits.label: E
deposits.title: LOADED CARRY + REPEATABLE ENGINE
deposits.effort: Rest 0:20; RPE 7. Record carry load; preserve posture and repeatable shuttle speed.

exercises.name: Farmer Carry
exercises.cue: Tall posture; short steps; crush the handles

exercises.name: Dopa Band Shuttle Run
exercises.cue: Fast feet; controlled turn; same output each round

martialSupplement.name: Dopa Band Spider Guard Escape
martialSupplement.home: Dopa Band + mat: spider-guard escape footwork and hip-angle recoveries
martialSupplement.cue: Relax shoulders; smooth hip angle; solo work supplements coaching
